in_arabic.name: أفراسياب
in_arabic.meaning: من أصل فارسية، يعني الشخص العظيم أو البطل الشجاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أفراسياب مشتق من اللغة الفارسية، ويعني الشخص العظيم أو البطل الشجاع. يعود أصل الاسم إلى الأساطير الفارسية، حيث كان أفراسياب ملكًا عظيمًا في تلك الأساطير. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يتمتع الاسم بتقدير كبير لما له من دلالة على الشجاعة وال greatness.

in_urdu.name: افراسیاب
in_urdu.meaning: فارسی سے ماخوذ، مطلب عظیم شخص یا بہادر ہیرو
in_urdu.long_meaning: افراسیاب کا نام فارسی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے عظیم شخص یا بہادر ہیرو۔ یہ نام فارسی پौरাণिक कथाओं سے جڑا ہوا ہے، جہاں افراسیاب ایک عظیم بادشاہ تھا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، اس نام کو بہت احترام حاصل ہے کیونکہ یہ بہادری اور عظمت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अफरासियाब
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ारसी से लिया गया, अर्थ महान व्यक्ति या वीर योद्धा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफरासियाब नाम फ़ारसी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ होता है महान व्यक्ति या वीर योद्धा। यह नाम फ़ारसी पौराणिक कथाओं से जुड़ा हुआ है, जहां अफरासियाब एक महान राजा था। इस्लामी संस्कृति में, इस नाम को बहुत सम्मान मिलता है क्योंकि यह बहादुरी और महानता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: افرسیاب
in_pashto.meaning: د فارس څخه اخیستل شوی، معنی لوی شخص یا اتل
in_pashto.long_meaning: افرسیاب نوم د فارسۍ ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوی شخص یا اتل دی. دا نوم د فارس افسانوي کیسو سره تړلی دی، چیرته چې افرسیاب یو لوی پاچا وو. د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې، دا نوم ډیر احترام لري ځکه چې د زړورتیا او لویتی نښه ده.

data.cultural_impact: The name Afrasiab carries a rich historical and cultural significance in Central Asia. Afrasiab is believed to be the historical name of the ancient city of Samarkand, which was once ruled by a powerful and legendary ruler of the same name. Afrasiab, the city, was the center of major civilizations, including the Sogdian, Sabirid, Samanid, and Timurid empires. Today, the city is known for its stunning architecture, including the famous Registan Square, the mausoleums of Shah-i-Zinda, and the Bibi-Khanym Mosque. The name Afrasiab serves as a reminder of the rich history, cultural achievements, and architectural wonders of Central Asia.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Afrasiab holds spiritual significance. Afrasiyab was a powerful and just ruler who upheld Islamic values and provided protection and safety to his people. He is remembered in Islamic history as a pious and virtuous leader who ruled with wisdom and fairness. The name Afrasiab is therefore a symbol of strength, justice, and protection. It reminder us of the importance of being a strong and just leader who upholds the principles of the faith and provides safety and security to those under their care. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and building a civilization characterized by beauty, wisdom, and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: According to Arab historians, Afrasiyab was the name of a legendary king of the city of Bukhara in Central Asia. He is believed to have ruled during the 5th century CE.
historical_references.context: Afrasiyab is most famous for his war against the Byzantine Emperor Justinian I, which is recounted in the historical epic poem 'The Story of Hayy ibn Yaqzan' by Ibn Tufayl.

historical_references.reference: Another interpretation of the name Afrasiyab comes from the ancient city of Samarkand, where Afrasiyab is said to have been a local king who ruled in the 5th or 6th century BCE. He is known for his role in the legendary Battle of the Elephants between the Achaemenid Empire and the Scythians.
historical_references.context: The Battle of the Elephants is described in the Greek historian Ctesias' 'Indica' and is one of the earliest recorded conflicts between the Persian and Scythian empires.
